hypothesis: Folding an offline residual Hadamard rotation into the BF16 weights before GPTQ W4 G128 (desc_act off, auto_gptq packing) removes the 14-vs-30 margin inversion and brings final-logit KL to EXL3 4bpw level, so the stock XPU W4A16 kernel serves EXL3-class quality.
changed_variable: Weight preprocessing before GPTQ W4 G128: none (plain, positive control) versus offline residual Hadamard fold with a boundary rotation sandwich; kernel, packing, heads, MTP and KV unchanged

workload.eval: /states/tokens_eval.safetensors 2 x 832 (starts 62% and 80%); final norm + lm_head in chunks of <= 256 positions, fp32 logits; per arm KL(BF16||arm) mean and p99, top-1 agreement vs BF16, held-out next-token NLL
workload.canaries: r01 sum(i*i for i in range(4)) expected 14 foil 30 (rendered 36 tokens, asserted), plus h03/n01/n02/n03 from results/2026/09/b70-margin-requant-pilot1-20260930T0855Z/heldout-manifest.json; rendered with the /bf16 chat template enable_thinking=False; step-0 margin = logit(first expected token) - logit(first foil token), first tokens asserted to differ
workload.sanity: computed and written BEFORE the gate, gate not evaluated if any fails: s1 r4_fp top-1 >= 99.9% and KL <= 1e-4 vs bf16; s2 gptq_plain r01 margin wrong sign; s3 exl3 r01 margin correct
workload.success_gate: Sanity (else blocked, unscored): the fp32 fold-exactness probe on every quantized layer has rel L2 <= 1e-4 (fold exact) [amended 2026-10-11 before any sealed run, RL-167: the original clause 'R4 with quantization off reproduces BF16 logits (top-1 >= 99.9 %, KL <= 1e-4)' measured bf16 storage noise of the folded weights, not harness exactness; r4_fp is still reported, ungated, and that storage noise stays inside every R4 arm's gated metric]; GPTQ-plain reproduces the defect (r01 margin wrong sign); EXL3 answers r01 correctly. R0 gate: best R4 arm has every canary margin correct, eval final-logit KL <= EXL3's and top-1 >= EXL3 - 0.1 pt. R1: exported checkpoint passes the exact-answer battery with EXL3's pass set. R2: >= 1.30x decode vs EXL3 4bpw in every confirmation pair, MTP acceptance within 0.05.

evidence_rationale: R0 of the RQ-27 kill ladder (research/2026/b70-r4-rotated-int4-design-20261011.md section 3). The block KL metric is forbidden (RL-161: blind on this model, channel 3994); the metric is end-to-end final-logit KL on held-out eval positions with a known-bad positive control (gptq_plain must reproduce the RL-092 14-vs-30 margin inversion) and a known-good reference (EXL3 bit-exact via pinned ref.py). Rotation Q is the same H_5120 as RL-067 (seed 20260925); GPTQ settings are the removed champion contract so R1/R2 can export unchanged for the stock XPUwNa16 kernel.
measurements_note: The adapter writes measurements.json in the run root with checks {correctness: sanity, quality: gate, measurement_validity, isolation}, per-arm JSON (raw/arm_*.json), per-layer log (raw/layers.jsonl, per-layer wall time and per-linear relative Frobenius error); integer codes + scales for the R4 arms go to /out only while >= 10 GiB stays free, with sha256 manifest + pointer (raw/codes_manifest.json) in the run root.
